evaluator.name: Graphics Complexity Evaluator
evaluator.description: Evaluates the Graphics Complexity dimension of qualitative text complexity for grades 3-12 reading assessment, producing a 4-level rubric rating with structured pedagogical detail. Multimodal: takes the passage text plus one image per graphic in scope, and rates how demanding those graphics are for the target grade and how much work it takes to read them together with the written text.

preprocessing.description: Compute the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level for the input text and bind it to {fk_score} in the prompt.

Read each item of input.graphics (a local file path or an http(s) URL), detect its media type from the file signature rather than the extension (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP), and encode it as an image content block. These blocks are attachments, not a text substitution: the evaluate_graphics_complexity step appends them to the user message after the rendered text, in input.graphics order, so that the Nth block matches the Nth label in {figure_labels}.

steps.description: Single multimodal LLM call that produces the EvaluatorOutput JSON: the rendered user text followed by one image block per graphic (see the graphics_blocks preprocessing step). The model rates each graphic on its own and checks whether any must be read against each other; the excerpt's complexity_score is the highest of those ratings. Those per-graphic working fields are used for internal validation and are not part of the returned output.

tolerance.notes: If allow_adjacent_levels is true, predictions within one rubric step of the expected label count as a pass. Slightly Complex < Moderately Complex < Very Complex < Exceedingly Complex; more_context_needed has no adjacency.
